objective: Make reconstructability a mandatory invariant for every newly created or modified scientific terminal/frozen state document.
legacy_policy: Existing untouched historical files are grandfathered as evidence only. Any future modification to a JSON document that writes a terminal scientific_state must satisfy this policy.
main_protection_note: Repository branch protection is currently not enforced by this policy. A direct noncompliant push may physically land but is scientifically invalid and the workflow must flag it; durable authority pointers must not promote it.
